Frozen decision surface changed (owner sign-off 2026-10-05): phase2_freeze --verify --candidate reports research_policy_sources.entry_cancellation (backend/organism/operator_cancellation.py) in addition to the base's source_hashes.entry_gates_dispatch and research_policy_sources.broker_state_safety; production needs a regenerated candidate_param_freeze.json and a new approved activation (new FROZEN_AT resets the forward clock).

tests/test_phase2_freeze.py::test_decision_surface_unchanged and ::test_verify_mode_passes_on_unchanged_surface fail by design until the release assembly regenerates candidate_param_freeze.json (deliberately not regenerated on this branch).

Live order-path behaviour changes: an entry older than 120 s at dispatch, or created in a regular session that has since closed, is no longer sent (expired); a dead-lettered or refused entry is released about 60-75 s after the dead letter once the broker answers 404 for its client key, so the symbol can be re-entered. A cause that rejects every attempt (for example buying power) now cycles, bounded by the engine's hourly entry throttle (12 in learning mode).

Residual race: a POST the broker processes more than 60 s after the worker's last failed attempt could appear after the absence proof; the trade-update stream would then attach its fills by client key, but the pending identity is already released.

Not covered: ambiguous (lookup-only) dead letters are still never finalized (C04-03), and rows dead-lettered before this release carry no record, so a pending identity one of them still holds needs the documented brain repair (docs/runbooks/PAPER_UPTIME.md).

Shadow mode and dry_run under ENVIRONMENT=production (C04-02, unchanged here) dead-letter every order; their entries are now proven absent and released instead of locking the symbol, so they cycle like a persistent rejection.
follow_ups: Release assembly: regenerate artifacts/phase2/candidate_param_freeze.json once for all frozen-code fixes, then activate (new FROZEN_AT, activation record, daily-evidence binding); research_policy_baseline.json stays unchanged.
C04-03: a separate lookup budget for ambiguous submissions and client-key recovery of rows without a broker id (alpaca_outbox.probe_order_absence tells a definitive 404 from a failed lookup).

C01-05: classify breaker-open dispatches as not sent and post-send transport errors as ambiguous; this branch's entry age and session limits are what make rescheduling entries safe, and ambiguous outcomes stay outside the dead-letter finalization.
C04-02: decide shadow-mode semantics (the engine stops submitting, or shadow rows are finalized with a not-sent marker) and stop writing a status the constraint forbids.
C04-04: claim one outbox event at a time and release unstarted claims on stop; a stranded entry now expires instead of being sent 30 minutes late.
Optional operator-run hand-off of pre-release dead letters to the worker's absence check (needs a policy for orders found at the broker long after they filled).
